reviews.title: Successful Data transfer is a problem
reviews.comment: Unable to get this drive to write any files completely with out data loss seems slow for an ssd and yes if it worked as expected then it would have been a great value but alas if something doesn’t work properly is saving really saving. If your like me then you hesitated after view the specifics as it’s substantially lower then every other drive out there and clearly there is a reason. I would avoid this drive all together and spare yourself the headache.
reviews.author: Official Comment

reviews.title: Great Product for the price
reviews.comment: Got the yesterday 4/20. I had bought it for my Eufy Home Base 3. It was easy to install and format. It is running like it should. I would recommend this to anyone who is looking to expand storage and a low cost.
reviews.author: STARadio G.

reviews.title: Reasonable drive for money, genuine capacity, slow but expected performance.
reviews.comment: Product works as intended, for speed it hits at the middle of the road, formatted correctly, and appears to be the correct capacity.  I ran a verifile test on it to make sure they hadn't cooked the firmware to falsely report a higher capacity.  Crystal disk mark shows a mix of performance consistent with a SATA SSD of this class.  It does not appear to get overly warm or produce much in the way of heat, even when under synthetic load.  I am likely to pickup another one, just based on the price.  I attached a crystal disk mark to give you an idea of what to expect.  This was in a Sabrent external controller connected directly to a USB 3.2 port.  It behaves like I expected a D-RAMless QLC drive to behave.
reviews.author: David B.

reviews.title: Unreliable, not value for money.
reviews.comment: Either faulty design, or fraudulent description. This was a replacement for the original item, and both failed in the same way: After being connected and operating for roughly an hour, the drive stops responding and disappears from the Operating System's list of devices.
reviews.author: Sandpiper

reviews.title: Worked in old windows 8 laptop.
reviews.comment: Perfect for an old laptop.  Definitely out performs the old 5400rpm spinning drive. Highly recommend it.
